question: If the radius of the base of a right circular cylinder is decreased by 15% and its height is increased by 149%, then what is the percentage increase (rounded to the nearest integer) in its volume?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Volume of Cylinder (V) ∝ r² × h Radius decrease factor = 1 − 0.15 = 0.85 Height increase factor = 1 + 1.49 = 2.49 New Volume Factor = (0.85)² × 2.49 = 0.7225 × 2.49 New Volume Factor = 1.799025 Percentage increase = (1.799025 − 1) × 100 ≈ 80% **∴ The correct answer is 80%.**
